title: anatomy of a song
system_instruction_addendum: SONG ANATOMY ADDENDUM: Walk through intro, build, drop, breakdown, outro on the playing track. Reference the audio you both hear, not music-theory jargon.

tutor_speak.text: a track moves through five sections — intro, build, drop, breakdown, outro.
the intro is sparse — usually drums or a single element, easy to mix into.
the build pulls energy up — risers, snare rolls, the kick getting busier.
the drop is the loudest, fullest section — the part the crowd was waiting for.
the breakdown drops the kick — the chord or melody sustains over thin air.
the outro thins out again — the place you mix out of.

hints.text: listen across the whole track first — the five sections will repeat.
tap continue when you can name each section from the audio.
